newsitem.title: JAPAN: Foreigners largest buyers of yen bonds in Aug - JSDA.
newsitem.headline: Foreigners largest buyers of yen bonds in Aug - JSDA.

text.p: Foreigners were the largest net buyers of yen bonds in August, the Japan Securities Dealers' Association (JSDA) said on Friday.

But many market participants were net sellers of yen bonds in the month, and the amount of monthly net sales in the whole market was the fifth-largest ever at 1.7353 trillion yen, it said. Net sales by life insurers and non-life insurers were the second-largest for any month.
The figures include Japanese government bonds, notes and Treasury bills, corporate bonds and bank debentures, the JSDA said.
